_meta.note: Compiled from secondary sources only; cbseacademic.nic.in could not be opened (TLS certificate mismatch). nulls = not verified. Per-year observed chapter marks are NOT available from any source found; officialMarks are blueprint/syllabus unit and chapter estimates.
_meta.standardVsBasic: Same 38Q / 80 marks / 5 sections for both 041 and 241. Differ in difficulty/typology: Standard ~54% remember+understand, 24% apply, 22% analyse/evaluate/create; Basic ~75% / 15% / 10% (2025 blueprint, Careers360, Dec 2024).

2023.competencyNote: 40% stated for 2022-23 by news summaries (aglasem/Careers360 roundup); not checked against circular

2024.competencyNote: 50% competency-based for Class 10 from 2024 per news reports of CBSE circular; MCQ/AR split 18+2 confirmed only from 2023-24 sample paper copy, not the actual 2024 paper

2025.internalChoice: 2 questions each in B, C, D; all 2-mark sub-parts in E

phase2.window: 2026-05-15 to 2026-05-21 (some sources say to 1 June / start 5 May; unresolved)
phase2.rule: optional improvement, up to 3 subjects, best of two scores counts, same full syllabus and similar pattern

2026.competencyNote: No 2026-specific figure found; 50% carried over from 2024-25 scheme which CBSE said was unchanged for 2025-26 and 2026-27

2027_session_2026_27.source: https://www.pw.live/news/cbse-board-exams-2027-sample-papers-marking-schemes-class-10-12 ; https://store.pw.live/blogs/school-exams/cbse-sample-papers-class-10-for-board-exams (sample papers state no change in design for 2026-27; secondary report)

chapters.name: Real Numbers
commonQuestionStyles: HCF/LCM of two or three numbers; HCF x LCM = product (assertion-reason)
Prove irrational (sqrt p, a+b sqrt p)
Prime factorisation / word problem on meeting times, bells, equal grouping
Decimal expansion terminating or not (2023 deletion of some topics noted)

chapters.name: Polynomials
commonQuestionStyles: Zeros from graph (MCQ)
Sum/product of zeros, find quadratic or find k
Relationship between zeros and coefficients

chapters.name: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
commonQuestionStyles: Consistency conditions with a1/a2, b1/b2, c1/c2; find k
Word problems: speed-distance, age, fractions, cost
Graphical/lines intersecting (Basic)

chapters.name: Quadratic Equations
commonQuestionStyles: Nature of roots via discriminant, find k
Solve by factorisation or formula
Word problem: speed/time, area, numbers, work-time

chapters.name: Arithmetic Progressions
commonQuestionStyles: nth term, nth term from end, sum of n terms
Find number of terms / which term equals value
Case study (AP named in 2026 Section E by two sources)

chapters.name: Coordinate Geometry
commonQuestionStyles: Distance formula: collinearity, equidistant point, shape identification
Section formula: ratio, point dividing, midpoint
Find unknown coordinate from condition

chapters.name: Triangles
commonQuestionStyles: BPT / converse proof or application (named in 2026 Standard)
Similar triangles proofs with parallel lines, ratio of areas
Pythagoras-based word problem

chapters.name: Circles
commonQuestionStyles: Tangent from external point equal lengths, find angle/length
Tangent perpendicular to radius
Quadrilateral circumscribing circle, cyclic quadrilateral properties (2026 reports)
Flagged tricky in 2026 Standard

chapters.name: Introduction to Trigonometry
commonQuestionStyles: Evaluate expression using standard-angle values
Find ratios from one given ratio

chapters.name: Trigonometric Identities
commonQuestionStyles: Prove an identity using sec2/tan2, sin2/cos2
Simplify expression

chapters.name: Applications of Trigonometry (Heights and Distances)
commonQuestionStyles: Angle of elevation/depression, tower/building/kite, two angles
Case study in Section E (named in 2026 by one source)

chapters.name: Areas Related to Circles
commonQuestionStyles: Sector / segment area, arc length
Area of region between circles or in a design/field with wipers, clock, cow tied

chapters.name: Surface Areas and Volumes
commonQuestionStyles: Combined solids (cylinder+hemisphere/cone) volume or surface area (2026 Section D example)
Conversion of solid melted/recast
Case study (named in 2026 Section E by one source)

chapters.name: Statistics
commonQuestionStyles: Median / mode of grouped data (2026 Standard)
Mean with missing frequencies (two unknowns, 2026 Section D)
Cumulative frequency / ogive if in syllabus: ogive deletion unverified

chapters.name: Probability
commonQuestionStyles: Single event with cards, dice, balls, letters, numbers
Two dice sum, probability of event (2026)
Flagged tricky in 2026 Basic

unitOfficialMarks.disagreement: pw.live 2025-26 page lists Number Systems 5 and Algebra 21; all other sources list 6 and 20

patternChanges.change: Syllabus rationalised (~30% cut): e.g. Constructions removed, some proofs, frustum, step-deviation, ogive etc. reported; details unreliable across blogs
Paper: 38 Q, 80 marks, A-E with case-study Section E (3 x 4). Section A reported as 20 MCQs

Competency-based share raised to 50% for Class 10; short/long answers cut to 30%; objective 20%. Section A now 18 MCQ + 2 assertion-reason; internal choice in 2 Q each of B, C, D and 2-mark parts of E
No structural change. Same 38Q/80 marks; Standard typology 54/24/22, Basic 75/15/10 published in blueprint
Two board exams introduced: Phase 1 (compulsory, Feb 2026; Maths 17 Feb) and optional Phase 2 (May 2026) to improve up to 3 subjects; best score counts; full syllabus; paper design unchanged
Sample papers state no change in question paper design/assessment pattern (secondary report); second exam continues

internalAssessment.split: Pen-paper test + multiple assessment 10 (5+5), portfolio 5, lab practical 5
